fichas.title: Theatres: Stage and experimental theatre
fichas.summary: Describes stage classifications under assembly regulations and the spatial and operational features of large stages, open stages, and single-room black-box theatres. Experimental configurations use mobile floor sections or podiums to vary the relationship between stage and audience, including arrangements for directed performance, dancing, lectures, conferences, and completely free use.
furniture_equipment: Extendable stands on rollers or air cushions
Travelling folding podiums with adjustable height
